about.title: Korean-Asian Tea, Crafted with Character
storyText: Geum Cha was created from a love of distinctive Asian tea and milk-based beverages.
Our menu brings together familiar flavors and creative combinations — from classic milk tea and fresh milk to matcha, roasted rice, pandan, chocolate, fruit and yogurt creations.
The idea is simple: create beautiful, satisfying drinks that feel familiar yet offer something new with every visit.
philosophyItems: Carefully selected ingredients and carefully balanced flavors
Rich, creamy textures combined with refreshing tea and fruit notes
A diverse menu inspired by Korean and Asian beverage culture
Flexible choices where available — sweetness, temperature, ice, size and toppings
Refined presentation designed to make every drink feel special
atmosphereText: Geum Cha is designed as a modern Asian tea house with a calm, sophisticated atmosphere.
Deep charcoal tones, warm golden light and subtle Korean-inspired details create an intimate environment for slowing down and enjoying a good drink.
Whether you're meeting friends, taking a break, going on a casual date or simply enjoying some quiet time, Geum Cha is a place to pause, sip and stay a little longer.
